purpose: Daily factual theme-priority snapshot based on freshness/materiality and current cross-asset significance. This file does not alter fundamental stock scores.
whatIsNewNow: August CPI +0.4% m/m headline, +0.3% core; Fed hike odds near 90%.
QatarEnergy seeking multi-year US LNG supply through 2031 after major Gulf LNG capacity loss.
Oracle/Z.AI/Anthropic financing reinforces AI capital intensity and cash-conversion risk.
HBM shortages drove 20-50% price increases for several Chinese AI accelerators.
AI-agent incidents and frontier-AI safety proposals increased cybersecurity relevance.
Copper/FCX reversed sharply after tariff-delay reports, exposing policy/inventory distortion in the prior squeeze.
whatMattersMostNow: Global LNG rerouting and replacement contracts

themes.name: Middle East Refined Products + Shipping Stress
themes.whyNow: Brent stayed above $100 after nearly reaching $110; Bab el-Mandeb and Saudi pipeline risks broadened the physical shock beyond Hormuz, while Friday diplomacy headlines caused a sharp oil retracement.
themes.marketTransmission: Diesel/jet inflation, tanker rates, insurance, freight, consumer inflation and rates.
themes.confirmation: Persistent route/infrastructure disruption plus tight distillates and high freight/insurance.
themes.invalidation: Durable reopening/repair plus normalized product cracks and shipping costs.
themes.nextTest: Weekend Gulf diplomacy, Saudi pipeline status and next EIA product data.

themes.name: Global Duration / Real-Yield + Weak-End Credit Stress
themes.whyNow: August CPI and PPI reinforced Fed tightening while the US 10Y approached 5% and the latest verified CCC yield-to-worst remained above 15%.
themes.marketTransmission: Valuation, housing, project underwriting, small caps and speculative duration.
themes.confirmation: 10Y remains near/above 5% and weak-end credit stays stressed.
themes.invalidation: Sustained yield compression with improving credit/breadth.

themes.name: Energy Security Rerouting + US LNG
themes.whyNow: QatarEnergy is seeking 2-3 mtpa/year of multi-year US LNG supply through 2031 after roughly 12.8 mtpa of Qatari capacity was damaged/offline.
themes.marketTransmission: US LNG contracts/utilization, Europe/Asia gas pricing, shipping and power costs.
themes.confirmation: Multi-year replacement contracts and sustained US LNG utilization.
themes.invalidation: Rapid Qatar restoration or deep demand destruction.
themes.nextTest: Contract announcements and US LNG feedgas/export data.

themes.name: AI Financing Quality + Cash Conversion
themes.whyNow: Oracle's negative FCF and large funding needs, Z.AI's $5bn raise and Anthropic's potential mega-IPO show how capital-intensive the next AI phase has become.
themes.marketTransmission: Debt/equity issuance, dilution, data-centre funding, supplier order quality and valuation.
themes.confirmation: Backlog converts to revenue/FCF without leverage rising faster.
themes.invalidation: Broad positive FCF inflection and falling funding costs.
themes.nextTest: Oracle cash flow/debt trajectory and hyperscaler issuance.

themes.name: Power / Grid / Cooling + Funded Demand
themes.whyNow: EIA/ISM evidence continues to show record electricity demand and long-lead transmission/generation purchasing.
themes.marketTransmission: Generation, substations, switchgear, transformers and cooling.
themes.confirmation: Funded/energized MW plus booked orders and cash conversion.
themes.nextTest: Supplier backlog, PPAs and energization data.

themes.name: AI Memory / HBM Scarcity + Electronics Inflation
themes.whyNow: Chinese AI accelerator prices rose 20-50% as HBM scarcity worsened; suppliers still expect multi-year memory tightness.
themes.marketTransmission: Accelerator costs, server BOM, smartphones/PCs/consoles and AI project budgets.
themes.confirmation: Elevated HBM/DRAM pricing and tight capacity persist.
themes.invalidation: Rapid capacity additions create sustained oversupply.
themes.nextTest: Micron Sep 30 earnings and HBM contract pricing.

themes.name: Agriculture Weather + Trade Rerouting
themes.whyNow: El Nino and energy costs remain inflation risks, but large inventories and diversified export supply reduce generalized food-scarcity risk.
themes.marketTransmission: Crop/input ratios, farmer margins, fertilizer and food inflation.
themes.confirmation: Crop conditions and export balances deteriorate materially.
themes.nextTest: Crop conditions, grain exports and fertilizer affordability.

themes.name: Selective AI Software / Cybersecurity
themes.whyNow: Fresh AI-agent intrusion incidents and proposed US frontier-AI duty-of-care rules make security a direct consequence of stronger autonomous models.
themes.marketTransmission: Security budgets, ARR, cloud/platform consolidation and AI governance.
themes.confirmation: Security ARR/billings growth and AI-security product adoption remain strong.
themes.invalidation: Security demand decelerates despite AI deployment.
themes.nextTest: CRWD/PANW pipeline and AI-security attach rates.

themes.name: Copper: Grid Scarcity vs Tariff/Inventory Distortion
themes.whyNow: The sharp copper/FCX reversal after tariff-delay reports confirms policy and inventory geography amplified the prior squeeze.
themes.marketTransmission: Grid equipment margins, miners, cables and inflation.
themes.confirmation: Physical premiums/inventories remain tight after price stabilizes.
themes.nextTest: FCX/copper stabilization, LME/COMEX inventories and tariff policy.

themes.name: Uranium / Nuclear Fuel-Cycle Scarcity
themes.whyNow: Structural nuclear buildout/fuel-security thesis remains intact, with no equally material new contracting catalyst in the latest cycle.
themes.marketTransmission: Uranium pricing, conversion/enrichment economics and nuclear capex.
themes.confirmation: New long-term contracting and capacity additions.
themes.invalidation: Contracting weakens materially or supply normalizes quickly.
themes.nextTest: Utility contracting and fuel-cycle capacity updates.

themes.name: Gold / Monetary Hedge
themes.whyNow: Gold rebounded Friday, but near-5% nominal yields and likely Fed tightening remain tactical headwinds.
themes.marketTransmission: Real yields, USD, reserve diversification and fiscal/geopolitical hedging.
themes.confirmation: Gold advances despite high real yields or yields roll over.
themes.invalidation: Persistent real-yield rise with breakdown in gold trend.

themes.name: ESS Demand vs Battery Manufacturing Overcapacity
themes.whyNow: Storage deployment remains strong while China's factory-approval pause confirms manufacturing overcapacity.
themes.marketTransmission: Cell margins, lithium demand, storage integration and grid economics.
themes.confirmation: Deployment grows while factory rationalization improves margins.
themes.nextTest: China capacity policy and storage deployment economics.
